GstWithholdingStatus.description: The status of GST withholding. Can be one of the following: * MATCHING - Form one lodged via PEXA and GST line item created * MANUAL - Form one not lodged via PEXA but GST line item created * NOT_LODGED - Form one not lodged via PEXA and no GST line item created * MISMATCH - Incorrect PRN and/or GST amount entered

ParticipantSettlementDateStatus.description: The status of settlement date acceptance by a participant. Can be one of the following: * ACCEPTED - Accepted * PENDING - Awaiting Response

SettlementDateStatus.description: The overall status of settlement date acceptance. Can be one of the following: * ACCEPTED - All Accepted * PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED - Pending others * PENDING - Pending * NO_ACCEPTANCE - No acceptance
